## Property address enrichment
1. Execute the workflow and upload a CSV (address column) or JSON array in the form. No fixed row cap; your plan quota and n8n resources apply.
2. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: name `x-apivex-key`, value your APIVex key. Select it in **Look up property**.
3. Inspect **Review results** and download the file from **Export results CSV**; `returned` means a property was returned, not that its address was verified.
Requests consume quota. This starter makes one request per unique address, with no automatic retries. Errors remain in output; fix them before rerunning. No schedule is enabled.
Guide: https://apivex.com/workflows/property-address-enrichment

parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV with an address column or a JSON array of addresses. One API request per unique address. Results are available in the n8n execution.
